image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a golden hamster (Syrian hamster) eating a peanut. The hamster has dense, multi-colored fur (golden, white, and grey/black patches). It is holding the peanut with its front paws. The background consists of soft bedding material and scattered food debris.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad head with prominent cheek pouches extending to shoulders.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject displays the characteristic broad head shape of a Syrian hamster. While the cheek pouches are not distended with food, the anatomical structure allowing for them is visible in the jawline width.
The visible eye is small, round, black, and reflects light naturally, consistent with the taxonomy.
One ear is clearly visible; it is rounded, fuzzy, and proportionally large relative to the head, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Stocky compact body with diminutive, rounded proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the torso is rounded and compact, covered in dense fur, fitting the 'stocky' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dense short fur in golden, brown, black, or white coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture appears dense and realistic. The coloration is a mix of golden/orange on the face and back, transitioning to white/cream on the belly, with some darker grey/black ticking on the head/ears. This matches the allowed color variations.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short legs with clawed digits; hind feet slightly elongated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front paws are visible holding the peanut. They show distinct, separate digits with natural positioning. The anatomy of the grip is biomechanically correct for a rodent.
The rear of the animal is obscured by the angle of the shot and the foreground bedding; the tail is not visible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species (Syrian/Golden Hamster) and rule out misclassification as other rodents like guinea pigs or mice.
To verify the structural integrity of the front paws gripping the peanut, ensuring no fused digits or impossible joint angles.
To check for edge bleeding between the fine whiskers/fur and the background, a common AI artifact in high-frequency detail areas.
To analyze the texture consistency of the complex foreground objects (peanut shell, wood shavings) for signs of melting or texture smearing.

focus_areas: Paw digit separation and grip mechanics on the peanut
Whisker sharpness and continuity against the background
Geometric plausibility of the peanut shell texture
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the paws and the peanut. AI often struggles with object-handling poses, resulting in fused fingers or objects that don't obey gravity. Also, inspect the whiskers for any 'halo' effects or sudden disappearances which indicate generation errors.
